title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an H1 opening and H4 field with the same body refer to one record item
summary: GDT735 fixes 24 complete bodies under four opaque written heads; GDT736 independently finds the H1/H4 body-profile pairing and their opening versus internal positions. Before assigning any head meaning, enumerate only complete admitted record units where H1 and H4 carry the exact same body, and preserve every intervening form. One semantic reading has H1 introduce an item whose state or property H4 later specifies; a rival uses the same body as a reusable form pattern for two different field values. A fixed full-record reading must retain one referent and a second independently written property under the first model. If no same-record repeated-body pair or no additional written property exists, record no capacity. This neither revives the discarded Latin-initial heads nor treats profile similarity as coreference.

design.mechanism: exact body repetition under written opening and internal head roles may preserve one record referent
design.unit: complete admitted records containing both H1+body and H4+the same body, with their intervening groups
design.contrast: one item introduced then specified versus two independent field values using a common form pattern
design.prediction: a frozen full-record reading supplies an overt item and later property without changing the item's identity; absent same-record capacity or independent property means no semantic test
